scope: Local observational comparison of complete installed-artifact acceptance processes and RPC timings; not a release gate or isolated startup benchmark.
retainedData: Projection preserving all process/RPC timings, checks and input hashes. Full runtime graph snapshots, requests and logs are omitted; raw report and log hashes are retained. Hashes are integrity links, not signed attestations.

sampling.processTimer: Date.now(), complete child lifecycle including setup/work/polling/300 ms cancellation wait/shutdown
sampling.rpcTimer: Date.now(), calls/totalMs/maxMs per method; not percentile latency
sampling.nativeRustDifference: Includes extra Rust tool turn; compare with its own baseline.

cordis.sourceIdentity: verified working-tree file hashes; baseCommit is metadata, not snapshot identity

baselineProvenance.limitation: Historical dirty source snapshot; baseCommit alone does not identify all inputs. Raw timing hashes match the committed acceptance record, but the old complete installed tree is not retained here.
